data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Arche,' meaning 'ruler' or 'beginning,' and 'le,' meaning 'long' or 'earth.' This name evokes images of ancient rulers and leaders who governed their lands with wisdom and strength. The name Archle carries the meaning “Ruler of the long earth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Archle usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the long earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
